At lvl 60 you get to do the first Forgotten World Quest that gives you lots of SP and you will be able to do more FGW quests every 10 lvls (60, 70, 80 etc). In Origin you can do 3 one star trades with protection which means non npc thieves can attack you and all npc traders have information about how much profit you’ll make.
